title: Italian child dies after decade-long E. coli battle
summary:
An Italian child who spent almost a decade in a coma after eating raw milk cheese has died.

Mattia Maestri died aged 13 after spending nine years in a coma having contracted an E. coli infection, which led to HUS from raw milk cheese in Trento in 2017.

title: Petting zoo linked to HUS cases reopens
summary:
Title: Petting zoo linked to HUS cases reopens

URL Source: https://www.foodsafetynews.com/2026/08/petting-zoo-linked-to-hus-cases-reopens/

Published Time: 2026-08-05T04:02:03.000Z

Markdown Content:
Eight children were hospitalized

![Image 1: Petting zoo linked to HUS cases reopens](https://storage.ghost.io/c/43/4e/434e508a-5e2f-4102-a53d-00bca10bb4bf/content/images/size/w30/2026/08/petting-zoo-farm-animals-goats.png)

Photo illustration

Published:August 05, 2026, 12:02 am

A petting zoo and farm in Belgium has been allowed to reopen after being connected to an E. coli outbreak.

Between late June and mid-July, eight children in the Brasschaat region were hospitalized with hemolytic uremic syndrome (HUS) resulting from Shiga toxin-producing E. coli (STEC) O26 infection. HUS is a severe complication associated with E. coli infections that causes kidney failure and can also cause brain damage and death. None of the children remain in a life-threatening condition.
